description: This Dart source file defines a mock implementation of a chat service used in a Flutter app for testing and offline purposes. It simulates a deterministic multi-turn interaction, returning predefined responses to facilitate testing UI components and the agent workflow without network dependency.

classes.name: MockChatService
classes.description: A mock implementation of ChatService that provides deterministic responses for offline testing.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the mock chat service to its initial state, resetting turn counter.

methods.name: _extractTag
methods.description: Extracts a specific tagged content from a string using regex.

methods.name: _buildOfflineFinalAnswer
methods.description: Constructs a deterministic mock final answer based on user question and observation.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Simulates sending a message and provides deterministic mock responses based on the current turn.
